Initial release of qa-security skill.

- Provides paid testing and security audit services for one-time delivery scenarios, including test plans, code reviews, vulnerability checks, and risk assessments.
- Structured in three payment phases: order creation, payment via clawtip, and post-payment service execution.
- Supports coverage suggestions, audit checklists, risk reports, pre-launch acceptance, and incident analysis frameworks.
- Requires outbound network, credential, and filesystem access.
- All user interactions conducted in Chinese.
